webos.note: Entry chunk = what a television parses before the channel appears, so this line is about startup, not total size. Measured on 2026-11-09 at 4917859: webos 47.9 KB, tizen 42.1 KB, vizio 37.4 KB. The growth is attributed, not guessed - the same throwaway-worktree rebuild used for scripts/bundle-budgets.json gives the pre-profile baselines tizen 29.9 KB and vizio 24.3 KB at 847fd10, and an esbuild metafile names the cause: core/src/server-config/ClientConfig.ts is 9,016 B minified and core/src/analytics/AnalyticsEndpoint.ts 1,372 B, both necessarily in the entry because the delivered channel profile is read and validated before any startup side effect (owner mandate 2026-11-07, CONFIGURATION.md): a kill switch that arrives after the side effects it cancels is not a kill switch. tizen's old 30 KB line had 0.1 KB of headroom, so any change at all tripped it - the same situation the vizio total line reported on 2026-11-08. Lines are set ~3 KB above measured. WEB-055 in the private plan of record carries the work that would give these bytes back (compact the validator table without losing a machine-readable reason, or move the validator out of the startup chunk without ever weakening fail-closed validation); raising a line here is not permission to stop hunting. webos measured 47.9 KB against this unchanged 55 KB line - it had headroom and stays as drawn.
